title: The abelian category of coefficient towers
statement:
Let $E/\Ql$ be finite and $T$ a scheme.

1. $\operatorname{Tow}(T,\mathcal O_E)$ is the category of
   $\mathcal O_{E,T}/\ell^\bullet$-modules in the topos of inverse systems
   (functors $\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}}\to$ sheaves) on $T_{\mathrm{proét}}$
   (compare Bhatt–Scholze, Section 3.5). It is a Grothendieck abelian category
   in which kernels, cokernels and filtered colimits are computed level by
   level; we use its ordinary derived category $D(\operatorname{Tow}(T,\mathcal O_E))$.
2. Evaluation at level $n$, $C_\bullet\mapsto C_n$, is an exact functor
   $\operatorname{Tow}(T,\mathcal O_E)\to\Mod(T_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_{E,T}/\ell^n)$; for
   $C_\bullet\in D(\operatorname{Tow}(T,\mathcal O_E))$ we write $C_n$ for its image
   in $D(T_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E/\ell^n)$.
3. The transition maps induce, for $m\leq n$, *reduction maps*
   $$
   C_n\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_{E,T}/\ell^n}\mathcal O_{E,T}/\ell^m\longrightarrow C_m
   \quad\text{in }D(T_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E/\ell^m),
   $$
   natural in $C_\bullet$ and compatible with composition $m'\leq m\leq n$.

proof.text: Use the existing vertical diagram-site sheaf criterion for the abelian-axioms theorem: the recorded product coefficient presheaf is a sheaf on that topology, and the identity-on-presheaves equivalence with module sheaves transports abelianness.

The commutative and ring-valued coefficient sequences have identical objects and adjacent quotient maps, hence are equal after forgetting commutativity. Apply normalized varying-ring uncurrying; all four sectionwise normalizations are retained.

Use the existing system-level theory for Grothendieck abelianness and evaluation coproducts; transport through the additive equivalence. Exact evaluation preserves coequalizers, so coproduct preservation gives all small colimits. Use the standard ordinary derived category.

Take the scalar assignment and canonical tensor coherence of the system-level theory. Apply coherent reductions for the exact normalized equivalence. These give the actual strict tensor adjunct, the comparison formula on every complex, the derived unit, and the composition equation. Assemble these fields without changing the statement. A simultaneous tower resolution is unnecessary because scalar coherence extends from K-flat resolutions at a single level before deriving the tower reductions.
